items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Theorem 7.3.8 at source lines 610-612: for any A and B the induced map trunc n (A x B) -> trunc n A x trunc n B is an equivalence. The proof (source lines 613-625) is a comparison of universal properties rather than a construction of an inverse: it is carried out by currying the mapping space into an n-type C (source lines 617-618) and then applying the universal property of truncation twice, for which one must know that B -> C is itself an n-type (source line 623). The last line records that the equivalence obtained this way is the one induced by |.|_n x |.|_n, which is a coherence statement that does not follow from the chain itself. The statement mentions none of this.
